types.label: 凸窗
types.handling: Reference the enclosing wall paths and hosted glazing once. The projection is not a cabinet or automatically walkable floor.

types.label: 窗台
types.handling: Record the source semantic and approximate plan position. Do not create furniture, floor or a dedicated 3D object.

types.label: 墙垛
types.handling: Reference its real wall runs once; do not add a second column or solid.

types.label: 独立柱
types.handling: Record a separate structural column when source evidence establishes one. Do not replace it with furniture; current draft conversion does not yet create native Column geometry.

types.label: 管井／竖井
types.handling: Reference source-supported enclosure walls and do not invent access. The sealed cavity itself creates no extra 3D object and does not require hidden slab or ceiling fidelity.

types.label: 阳台／露台
types.handling: Optional source semantic only. Never create, close or alter a room because it is classified as balcony/terrace; the generic bare-room envelope and hosted openings already own all geometry.

types.label: 设备平台
types.handling: Record the source semantic and approximate plan position. Do not extend living floor or create furniture or a dedicated 3D object.

types.label: 固定花池／种植平台
types.handling: Require a drawn built-in planting boundary; loose plant symbols alone do not establish a structural planter. A visible built-in planter remains a scene-support gap until modeled.

types.label: 栏杆／护栏
types.handling: Record observed guard evidence. A standalone railing remains a separate visible asset when required; it must not silently become a wall/window.

types.label: 楼梯
types.handling: Record tread or flight evidence and only visible up or down direction. Never infer an unseen destination floor, rise or ceiling hole.

types.label: 挑空／楼板洞口
types.handling: Record an explicit visible or reachable void. Never close it with inferred walkable floor; floor subtraction remains unsupported until a dedicated deterministic contract exists.
